meta.name: lifecycle-messaging
meta.description: Designs automated email and SMS programs — welcome and onboarding sequences, nurture, re-engagement, transactional messaging, and the timing and segmentation behind them. Use this to build or fix an email sequence, plan lifecycle automation, improve open or click performance, set up SMS flows, or decide what messages a customer should receive and when.

copy.tagline: 规划并优化客户的邮件与短信自动触达流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要搭建客户邮件或短信的自动营销流程
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize automated email and SMS customer journeys
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run customer messaging and need automated email or SMS flows.

howto.what: 根据客户所处阶段设计自动邮件与短信流程，规划欢迎、培育、重新参与等序列的时机和规则，并诊断打开率、退订等表现，提供合规建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建或修复邮件序列、规划生命周期自动化、设置短信流程等，或决定客户接收消息的时机与内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新人欢迎邮件序列，第一封当天发出。
say.note: 会按欢迎序列三阶段规划内容和发送时机。

say.text: 为什么我的邮件打开率低？帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 会按低打开的三类原因排查，先建议查投递声誉。

say.text: 给有流失风险的客户写一条重新激活短信，尊重他们时区的安静时间。
say.note: 会结合短信合规要求草拟文案。

howto.what_en: Designs automated email and SMS programs based on customer stage (signup, activated, habitual, at-risk, lapsed), plans timing and segmentation, and diagnoses open/unsubscribe performance. Provides compliance guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build or fix an email sequence, plan lifecycle automation, set up SMS flows, or decide what messages customers receive and when.

say_en.text: Help me design a welcome email sequence for new signups, with the first email sent on day one.
say_en.note: It will structure content and timing per the three welcome phases.

say_en.text: Why is my email open rate low? Run a diagnosis.
Write a re-engagement SMS for at-risk customers, respecting quiet hours in their timezone.
say_en.note: It will draft copy with SMS compliance requirements in mind.
